notes: Fresh check for the 7 Nov 2026 re-link of Swedish rock samples to the SGU occurrences (geochem.sample_occurrence_links). Not part of the gate.

questions.q: How many Swedish rock samples are within 500 m of a copper occurrence?

truth.n: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.sample_id) FROM geochem.sample_occurrence_links l JOIN geochem.samples s ON s.sample_id = l.sample_id JOIN core.occurrences o ON o.occurrence_id = l.occurrence_id WHERE s.source_system = 'SWEDEN_SGU_LITHOGEOCHEMISTRY' AND l.distance_m <= 500 AND 'Cu' = ANY(o.commodities)

questions.judge: Uses geochem.sample_occurrence_links (or an equivalent distance query) to count Swedish SGU lithogeochemistry samples within 500 m of an occurrence with copper, giving a number close to the truth, and notes that proximity is not proof a sample belongs to the deposit. Credits SGU.

questions.q: What do Swedish rock samples near Garpenberg show for zinc and lead?
questions.judge: Finds rock samples near the Garpenberg occurrence(s) (via sample_occurrence_links or a distance search), reports zinc and lead statistics (count, median and/or max in ppm or %) for those samples, says they are SGU lithogeochemistry samples (many drill core at the collar position) and that proximity does not prove the sample is ore. Does not invent values.
